answer: Coordinated Action Price Index. Every identity pays a per-period fee proportional to the number of co-signed actions it shares with others in the same window, so synchronized clusters get charged as one unit. A lone fable costs little; two hundred puppets acting in lockstep pay near-quadratic rates, priced like a single crystal of coordination. Fees are escrowed in a vault and refunded only after the cluster disperses for several periods. Sybil swarms thus pay far more than honest solo agents for the same throughput.
